text:
emma-cs: Heads-up: Miramar Health has a live pilot tomorrow 08:00 PT. During the rehearsal they pegged our us-west edge and APACs saw p95 spikes. They asked for a temporary regional allowlist + short rate bump in us-west-2 and ap-south-1. Renewal review in 12 days, account execs are nervous after last demo hiccups.
raj-ops: OK. Please paste CIDRs, partner vendors, and expected QPS. Also any compliance notes?
emma-cs: Miramar provided `34.210.11.22/32` and partner PulseMetrics `34.212.0.0/23`. Expect short bursts up to ~1300 qps for ~20-30m, normal steady 180 qps. They noted logs are pseudonymized, but execs want evidence of stability.
mina-net: Suggest AL-MIR-01 allowlist + TEMP_SPIKE_8H policy capped at 1800 qps, burst window 30m, TTL 8h auto-revoke. Pin routing to us-west-2 & ap-south-1 to avoid cross-region tail latency. We'll also pre-warm KV prefixes and embeddings for their common prompts. Need security sign-off for partner CIDR and vendor handshake.
gabi-sec: Security: require an AUP signature from Miramar and a vendor attestation from PulseMetrics. Prefer mTLS for partner traffic; if they only have TLS present a short attestation and rotate certs within 72h. Add audit entry to ticket CS-14122. 8h TTL is OK with auto-revoke + audit logging.
owen-ae: I'll escalate renewal watch to the account team and prep an executive note. Recommend a 15m runbook call 45m before demo with their infra lead.
emma-cs: Miramar infra lead is claire@miramar.health; I've looped her in. She confirmed the CIDRs and said they can hit ~1.4k qps for a 25m run if needed.
raj-ops: Plan (will schedule at 07:30 PT to warm):
```
POST /admin/allowlists
{'name':'AL-MIR-01','cidrs':['34.210.11.22/32','34.212.0.0/23'],'ttl':'8h','auto_revoke':true}
POST /policies/rate
{'name':'TEMP_SPIKE_8H','max_qps':1800,'burst_window_sec':1800,'regions':['us-west-2','ap-south-1']}
```
mina-net: LGTM. After apply I'll run `kv-warm --prefix miramar:session` and pre-populate embeddings cache for their common prompts to reduce token regen cold starts.
gabi-sec: Add note to CS-14122 that partner must rotate certs and upload attestation. If we detect anomalous pattern (sustained >2x expected baseline) we'll revoke immediately.
deploy-bot: allowlist AL-MIR-01 scheduled at 2026-08-12T14:30:00Z by raj-ops
emma-cs: Thanks team :pray: I'll run the 15m runbook with Claire and follow up with a short post-demo pulse to capture latency + NPS. Marking renewal on watch.
raj-ops: Applied and pinned routing. Monitoring shows connections healthy during warm-up. No immediate error spikes.
emma-cs: Demo finished  initial peak ~1.25k qps for ~18m, p95 in us-west dropped from 380ms -> 72ms after the change and ap-south p95 down to 140ms after KV warm. Claire asked if we can add PulseMetrics analytics CIDR `34.213.0.0/24` for 3h so they can finish a backfill run.
gabi-sec: 3h ephemeral add OK if PulseMetrics provides attestation in ticket CS-14122 and we limit token scopes. Manual approval + audit log required.
raj-ops: Adding `34.213.0.0/24` TTL 3h with auto-revoke. AL-MIR-01 updated.
mina-net: Warmed the additional prefixes. Monitoring shows stable connections and no tail risk.
owen-ae: Demo success  execs pleased, renewal moved from watch -> green/monitor. I'll update CRM and schedule 7-day follow-up.
emma-cs: I'll send the post-demo pulse (latency snapshot + brief NPS) and attach runbook notes to CS-14122. Great work all! :tada:
